$comment: Provider-neutral MCP config for Modules. Claude Code reads this file natively; other agents map these entries to their own config. Aligned with the org standard set (see ../claims/mcp.json): linear + nx-mcp + shadcn, plus playwright for website verification. NOTE: Claude Code only reads the 'mcpServers' key — a 'servers' key is ignored.

linear.$comment: Linear issues/projects — agents read and update the work items they're acting on.

nx-mcp.$comment: Project graph, targets, and generators for this nx monorepo so agents reason about the workspace instead of guessing.

shadcn.$comment: shadcn component registry — browse/add UI components into bragi's React islands (Tailwind-based).

playwright.$comment: Drives a real browser against the website — the behavioral/visual verification loop for bragi.
